content:
Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 will be unveiled tomorrow, and a last-minute leak may reveal new features and other information about watchOS 27 on the latest models.

New Apple Watch features may include a "Readiness" app, richer strength training options, and more

Over the past few days, X user pdfu has published multiple previously undisclosed findings from Apple code.

He shared evidence that HomePod will gain surround sound and "Party Mode" features, and detailed a number of professional photography features reportedly coming to the camera app in iOS 27.

Earlier, pdfu also posted on X detailing several Apple Watch changes discovered in watchOS 27 code.

His findings mainly involve four features:

  • A brand new "Readiness" app
  • Richer strength training
  • A new optical sensing system for Apple Watch
  • Hints of 128GB storage

Regarding the "Readiness" app, pdfu wrote:

Although no further details are available, judging from the app's name and its placement next to Workout, its functionality appears similar to what is offered by third-party wearables like the Oura Ring.

Update: Mark Gurman says "Readiness" will be a variant of the "Vitals" app.

As for strength training, it sounds like Apple wants to build a fully featured Workout rival that can compete with other strength training apps. For example, "a new implementation could describe every set and record each set's reps, weight, equipment, body parts used, and duration."

The new optical sensing system aligns with earlier rumors that the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and possibly the Series 12 will see major internal sensor changes. Finally, there's evidence that the new S-series chip used in Apple's latest Watch models will offer 128GB of storage.

Some changes appear tied to new hardware, but others, such as the "Readiness" app, are hoped to be available on older models with watchOS 27.
